name: key-model-v2-hardening-reference-vectors
description: Self-contained passkey-master reference vector. Run: bun install && bun passkey-master-vector.ts > passkey-master-vector.json — from THIS directory. Imports ONLY the published 5.0.1 @aztec/foundation plus node:crypto (a deliberately DIFFERENT HKDF implementation than the wallet's WebCrypto, so a consistently mis-wired wallet HKDF cannot self-consistently pass); never the repo's own helpers.
